He called himself a dead dog. The king gave him a seat at the table. 👑

Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son, was dropped at five years old and lame for life. Years later King David asked, “Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul?” Not to punish, but to show kindness. He restored his land and sat him at the king's table, still “lame on both his feet” (2 Samuel 9:13). That's grace: you don't earn the seat, you're brought to it.

Did you know this story? Yes or no 👇

Guess the Bible character in 3 clues 🕵️ Which clue gave it away: 1, 2 or 3? 👇

His real name was Joses, but the apostles called him Barnabas, “the son of consolation” (Acts 4:36). He gave away his land, and when the whole church was afraid of the newly converted Saul, he was the one who brought him to the apostles. Every youth group needs a Barnabas.
